title: Reports
description: Operational reports: the API's figures, previewed here and exported in full
unavailable: Your role cannot open this report

notes.sales: Every order of the period with net, discount, shipping, VAT and gross
notes.sales_tax: Each document with output VAT in the month
notes.payments_by_channel: Payments with fees, WHT, net and settlement date
notes.orders: Where each order stands, with its milestone dates
notes.quotations: Quotations saved in the period and their conversion
notes.campaign_usage: Redemptions, discount given and capped amounts per campaign and promotion
notes.points_liability: Opening, earned, redeemed, expired and closing points per month, with value
notes.ar_aging: Open receivables at a date by age
notes.ap_aging: Open payables at a date by age
notes.payout_history: Payouts to factories and vendors in the period
notes.claims: Claims submitted in the period with liability, amount and resolution

chooseFilters: Choose the required filters, then run the report
truncatedExport: Export the file for all of them
